### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. It will produce the goods, services, knowledge, and care we need—freeing us to live without selling our time to survive.

2. We are approaching the end of work as an economic necessity. If we build superintelligent AI within 20 years, it will make compulsory labor obsolete. Work may remain a choice, but no human will need a job to live.

3. Superintelligent AI will create unprecedented abundance. If it is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Our task now is to ensure that freedom and prosperity belong to everyone.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. This technology will be able to perform every task required to produce the goods, services, knowledge, and care our societies need. We will no longer have to sell our time to survive, endure jobs we dislike, or organize our lives around earning a wage. Work may remain a choice—a source of purpose, craft, service, or community—but it will cease to be an economic necessity. We must prepare now for that transformation, ensuring the abundance created by superintelligent AI belongs to everyone and frees every person to live on their own terms.
